Aardvark voluntarily paused its Phase 3 HERO trial in February 2026 after discovering reversible cardiac observations, causing a 56% stock decline. The FDA subsequently placed a full clinical hold on ARD-101 in May 2026, resulting in an additional 32.1% stock drop. The lead plaintiff deadline is October 13, 2026.

Influenza is expected to become the leading indication by 2035, while North America remains the largest regional market.

top.title: Atrial Fibrillation Treatment Devices Market Trends and Forecast, 2035 | Includes Profiles of Abbott, AtriCure, Boston Scientific, Johnson & Johnson, and Medtronic
top.summary: The global atrial fibrillation treatment devices market is expected to grow at a 13.1% CAGR from $9.6 billion in 2026 to $29 billion by 2035, driven by aging populations, rising AF prevalence affecting 50-60 million people worldwide, and increasing adoption of advanced ablation and left atrial appendage closure technologies. Pulsed field ablation is forecast to generate over 60% of market revenue by 2035, while North America will retain approximately 50% of global market share. Asia-Pacific is expected to register the fastest regional growth.

top.title: Intravascular Lithotripsy Market Size to Reach USD 4.19 Billion by 2035 as Coronary and Peripheral IVL Adoption Accelerates – SNS Insider
top.summary: The global Intravascular Lithotripsy (IVL) market is projected to grow from USD 1.01 billion in 2025 to USD 4.19 billion by 2035, expanding at a 15.3% CAGR. Growth is driven by increasing prevalence of calcified coronary and peripheral artery disease, adoption of minimally invasive procedures, and expanding peripheral IVL applications. North America leads with 58% market share, while Asia-Pacific is the fastest-growing region.

top.title: Kaplan Fox Notifies Investors of Cogent Communications Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: CCOI) of the Lead Plaintiff Deadline on September 21, 2026
top.summary: Kaplan Fox has filed class action lawsuits against Cogent Communications Holdings, PROCEPT BioRobotics, and EquipmentShare.Com Inc. The primary case involves Cogent, where investors claim the company misrepresented demand for optical wavelengths and inflated order backlogs that never materialized into paying customers. Following CEO David Schaeffer's admission of customer delays in wavelength installations on May 4, 2026, Cogent's stock fell 29% to $16.37 per share. Lead plaintiff deadlines range from September 21-22, 2026.

top.title: Cogent Communications Holdings Securities Fraud Class Action Result of Undisclosed Demand and Backlog Issues and approximately 29% Stock Decline - Investors may Contact Lewis Kahn, Esq, at Kahn Swick & Foti, LLC
top.summary: Cogent Communications Holdings (CCOI) faces a securities fraud class action lawsuit for allegedly failing to disclose material information about its optical wavelength backlog and demand issues during February 29, 2024 to May 1, 2026. The company's stock declined approximately 29%. Investors who purchased shares during this period have until September 21, 2026 to file lead plaintiff applications. Allegations include misrepresentation of backlog orders, customer delivery issues, unachievable revenue targets, and undisclosed risks related to CEO David Schaeffer's stock pledging activities.

top.title: INVESTOR ALERT: Pomerantz Law Firm Reminds Investors with Losses on their Investment in Cogent Communications Holdings, Inc. of Class Action Lawsuit and Upcoming Deadlines – CCOI

The lawsuit stems from Cogent's repeated misrepresentations regarding its wavelength business performance, including overstated backlog figures, missed installation targets, and undisclosed operational constraints. The company's stock declined significantly following multiple earnings announcements that revealed lower-than-expected revenues and customer connections. Investors who purchased Cogent securities during the class period have until September 21, 2026, to request Lead Plaintiff status.

It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.

This regulatory milestone enables the project to support preliminary economic assessment studies, addressing a critical gap in Western rare earth feedstock development.

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options lean up

reasons.en: calls richer than puts by +2.9 vol pts vs peers — strong informed bullish lean
reasons.zh: 看涨比看跌贵 +2.9 个波动点（相对同业） — 知情资金强烈偏多

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

top.summary: Digital Realty has been selected as an operator under Singapore's second Data Center Call for Application (DC-CFA2) to develop a 50MW data center facility on Jurong Island. This expansion strengthens Digital Realty's position in Asia-Pacific and builds on its existing operations in Singapore since 2010.

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options neutral

reasons.en: calls modestly richer than puts (+0.8 vol pts vs peers) — mild bullish lean
reasons.zh: 看涨略贵于看跌（+0.8 个波动点（相对同业））— 温和偏多

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

top.title: Kaplan Fox Notifies Investors of Cogent Communications Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: CCOI) of the Lead Plaintiff Deadline on September 21, 2026
top.summary: Kaplan Fox has filed class action lawsuits against Cogent Communications Holdings, PROCEPT BioRobotics, and EquipmentShare.Com Inc. top.title: Wix.com Ltd. Notice of September 22, 2026 Application Deadline for Class Action Lawsuit - Contact Lewis Kahn, Esq. at Kahn Swick & Foti, LLC, Before Application Deadline

top.title: Greenland Rare Earth Project Books Its First Indicated Resource
top.summary: Greenland Mines Ltd. announced the first S-K 1300 technical report for its Sarfartoq neodymium-praseodymium rare earth project in Greenland, achieving a landmark classification of 6.9 million tonnes at Indicated resource status—the first in 15 years of project history. The report models combined open pit and underground mining scenarios (Hybrid case) and includes a strategic partnership with Neo Performance Materials, which gains offtake rights on up to 60% of future production. This regulatory milestone enables the project to support preliminary economic assessment studies, addressing a critical gap in Western rare earth feedstock development.

top.title: Bronstein, Gewirtz & Grossman LLC Urges HDFC Bank Limited Investors to Act: Class Action Filed Alleging Investor Harm
top.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against HDFC Bank Limited alleging that the bank made materially false and misleading statements regarding its financial performance. The complaint claims HDFC Bank camouflaged payments as marketing spend to pay higher interest to a state firm to induce deposits, activities allegedly approved by senior management that likely violated regulations. The class period covers purchases between July 17, 2023 and May 26, 2026, with a lead plaintiff deadline of October 13, 2026.

top.title: HDFC Bank Limited Securities Fraud Class Action Result of Deceptive Interest Payments and Approximately 4% Stock Decline - Investors may Contact Lewis Kahn, Esq, at Kahn Swick & Foti, LLC
top.summary: HDFC Bank Limited faces a securities class action lawsuit for failing to disclose that it disguised approximately Rs 45 crore ($4.7 million) as marketing expenditures to pay above-market interest rates to Maharashtra State Road Development Corporation. top.title: HUBG INVESTOR ALERT: Holzer & Holzer, LLC Reminds Investors of the August 28, 2026 Lead Plaintiff Deadline in the Hub Group, Inc. Securities Class Action
top.summary: A shareholder class action lawsuit has been filed against Hub Group, Inc. alleging false and misleading statements regarding premature transaction recognition, understatement of costs, and ineffective internal controls. Investors who purchased shares between April 28, 2023 and May 11, 2026 and suffered losses are encouraged to contact the law firm by the August 28, 2026 lead plaintiff deadline.

top.title: Hub Group, Inc. (NASDAQ: HUBG) Faces New Scrutiny: Nasdaq Non-Compliance Notice Over Late Form 10-Q Amid Securities Class Action- Hagens Berman
top.summary: Hub Group, Inc. (NASDAQ: HUBG) has received a Nasdaq non-compliance notice for failing to timely file its Form 10-Q quarterly report. This development comes amid an ongoing securities class action lawsuit alleging the company made false and misleading statements about financial reporting, including premature revenue recognition and understatement of transportation costs. The company's stock declined approximately 18% in February 2026 and 13% in May 2026 following corrective disclosures, erasing over $870 million in market capitalization. The lead plaintiff deadline for the class action is August 28, 2026.

top.title: Greenland Rare Earth Project Books Its First Indicated Resource
top.summary: Greenland Mines Ltd. announced the first S-K 1300 technical report for its Sarfartoq neodymium-praseodymium rare earth project in Greenland, achieving a landmark classification of 6.9 million tonnes at Indicated resource status—the first in 15 years of project history. The report models combined open pit and underground mining scenarios (Hybrid case) and includes a strategic partnership with Neo Performance Materials, which gains offtake rights on up to 60% of future production. This regulatory milestone enables the project to support preliminary economic assessment studies, addressing a critical gap in Western rare earth feedstock development.

The electrochemical application segment held 44% market share in 2025 and is expected to grow at 8.34% CAGR, while secondary supply (recycled iridium) is anticipated to expand at 9.27% CAGR through 2035.

top.title: INTU FINAL DEADLINE: ROSEN, TRUSTED INVESTOR COUNSEL, Encourages Intuit Inc. Investors with Losses in Excess of $100K to Secure Counsel Before Important September 8 Deadline in Securities Class Action Filed by the Firm- INTU
top.summary: Rosen Law Firm has filed a class action lawsuit against Intuit Inc. on behalf of investors who purchased common stock between February 25, 2025 and June 1, 2026. Investors with losses exceeding $100,000 are encouraged to contact the firm before the September 8, 2026 deadline to serve as lead plaintiff.

Growth is driven by increasing prevalence of calcified coronary and peripheral artery disease, adoption of minimally invasive procedures, and expanding peripheral IVL applications. North America leads with 58% market share, while Asia-Pacific is the fastest-growing region.

gex_confirm.label: Options caution

reasons.en: deep long-gamma (+17.9% over the flip) — dealers pin & fade breakouts
reasons.zh: 深度多头 Gamma（高于翻转位 +17.9%）— 做市商钉价、压制突破

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options lean down

reasons.en: puts richer than calls by -11.1 vol pts vs peers — protection strongly bid
reasons.zh: 看跌比看涨贵 -11.1 个波动点（相对同业） — 保护性看跌被大力买入

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

top.title: The continuing business generated revenue of DKK 396.3 million, compared with DKK 390.1 million in the same period last year. Operating profit (EBIT) was DKK 34.6 million, compared with DKK 31.7 million in the same period last year.
top.summary: Gabriel Holding A/S reported 2% revenue growth in continuing operations to DKK 396.3 million with operating profit of DKK 34.6 million. The company divested its European furniture manufacturing business to Leggett & Platt post-quarter end, resulting in goodwill impairment of DKK 22.0 million. Full-year guidance for continuing operations was revised to DKK 528-532 million revenue and DKK 44-46 million EBIT. The company initiated a share buy-back programme with 59,462 treasury shares held after 9 months.

top.title: Den fortsættende forretning realiserede en omsætning på 396,3 mio. kr. mod 390,1 mio. kr. i samme periode sidste år. Det primære resultat (EBIT) blev 34,6 mio. kr. mod 31,7 mio. kr. i samme periode sidste år.
top.summary: Gabriel Holding A/S reported 2% revenue growth in continuing operations to 396.3 million DKK in the first nine months, with EBIT increasing to 34.6 million DKK. The company narrowed its full-year guidance for continuing operations to 528-532 million DKK revenue and 44-46 million DKK EBIT. FurnMaster furniture division was sold to Legget & Platt post-quarter end, resulting in goodwill writedowns of 22.0 million DKK.

top.title: El Pollo Loco® Declares September 9 National Grilled Chicken Day
top.summary: El Pollo Loco announced that National Day Calendar has officially recognized September 9 as National Grilled Chicken Day following a year-long campaign. The chain is celebrating with free chicken promotions for Loco Rewards members on September 9 and launching the Loco Hall of Flame Music Challenge (September 10-23) offering free chicken for life as the grand prize. The brand will also feature iconic menu items and deals throughout September.

top.title: Sodexo réalise une émission obligataire d’un montant de 1 100 000 000 d’euros
top.summary: Sodexo has successfully issued a €1.1 billion euro-denominated bond in two tranches: €600 million maturing in 2032 at 4.00% and €500 million maturing in 2036 at 4.50%. The proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes and to refinance an existing €800 million bond maturing in April 2027. The new bonds are rated BBB by S&P and Baa1 by Moody's, and will be listed on Euronext Paris.

top.summary: Sodexo successfully issued EUR 1.1 billion in euro-denominated bonds across two tranches maturing in 2032 and 2036 with coupons of 4.00% and 4.50% respectively. The bonds are rated BBB by S&P and Baa1 by Moody's, reflecting the company's strong access to capital markets and disciplined debt management.

top.title: Atrial Fibrillation Treatment Devices Market Trends and Forecast, 2035 | Includes Profiles of Abbott, AtriCure, Boston Scientific, Johnson & Johnson, and Medtronic
top.summary: The global atrial fibrillation treatment devices market is expected to grow at a 13.1% CAGR from $9.6 billion in 2026 to $29 billion by 2035, driven by aging populations, rising AF prevalence affecting 50-60 million people worldwide, and increasing adoption of advanced ablation and left atrial appendage closure technologies. Pulsed field ablation is forecast to generate over 60% of market revenue by 2035, while North America will retain approximately 50% of global market share. Asia-Pacific is expected to register the fastest regional growth.

top.title: Global Veterinary Medical Devices Market to Reach $9.1 Billion by 2030, Driven by Rising Pet Ownership and Technological Innovation in Animal Healthcare
top.summary: The global veterinary medical devices market is projected to grow from $6.5 billion in 2024 to $9.1 billion by 2030 at a 6.1% CAGR, driven by pet humanization trends, expanding pet insurance coverage, and AI-enabled diagnostic innovations. North America dominates with 55.9% market share, while emerging markets present long-term growth opportunities.

top.title: Intravascular Lithotripsy Market Size to Reach USD 4.19 Billion by 2035 as Coronary and Peripheral IVL Adoption Accelerates – SNS Insider
top.summary: The global Intravascular Lithotripsy (IVL) market is projected to grow from USD 1.01 billion in 2025 to USD 4.19 billion by 2035, expanding at a 15.3% CAGR. Growth is driven by increasing prevalence of calcified coronary and peripheral artery disease, adoption of minimally invasive procedures, and expanding peripheral IVL applications. North America leads with 58% market share, while Asia-Pacific is the fastest-growing region.

top.title: Greenland Rare Earth Project Books Its First Indicated Resource
top.summary: Greenland Mines Ltd. announced the first S-K 1300 technical report for its Sarfartoq neodymium-praseodymium rare earth project in Greenland, achieving a landmark classification of 6.9 million tonnes at Indicated resource status—the first in 15 years of project history. The report models combined open pit and underground mining scenarios (Hybrid case) and includes a strategic partnership with Neo Performance Materials, which gains offtake rights on up to 60% of future production. This regulatory milestone enables the project to support preliminary economic assessment studies, addressing a critical gap in Western rare earth feedstock development.

The results support NevGold's strategy to expand a domestic antimony resource, a critical mineral for U.S. defense and industry.

top.title: Onco360® Has Been Selected as a National Pharmacy Partner for RASONQUE™ (daraxonrasib)
top.summary: Onco360, the nation's leading independent specialty pharmacy, has been selected as a pharmacy partner by Revolution Medicines for the launch of RASONQUE (daraxonrasib), a RAS GTPase inhibitor for metastatic pancreatic adenocarcinoma. The drug showed significant clinical benefits in the phase 3 RASolute-302 trial, with median PFS of 7.3 months and OS of 13.2 months in RAS G12 mutation patients compared to 3.5 months and 6.6 months respectively for chemotherapy.

top.title: U.S. FDA Approves Revolution Medicines’ RASONQUE™ (daraxonrasib), the First Broad RAS-Targeted Medicine in Metastatic Pancreatic Cancer
top.summary: The FDA has approved RASONQUE (daraxonrasib), developed by Revolution Medicines, as the first targeted RAS inhibitor for treating metastatic pancreatic adenocarcinoma in patients who have received prior systemic therapy or are not candidates for multiagent chemotherapy. In the Phase 3 RASolute 302 trial, RASONQUE reduced the risk of death by 60% compared to chemotherapy, with median overall survival of 13.2 months versus 6.7 months, and demonstrated manageable safety with improved quality of life measures.

top.title: Sodexo completes a euro-denominated bond issuance of EUR 1,100,000,000
top.summary: Sodexo successfully issued EUR 1.1 billion in euro-denominated bonds across two tranches maturing in 2032 and 2036 with coupons of 4.00% and 4.50% respectively. The proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes and to redeem outstanding EUR 800 million bonds due in April 2027. The bonds are rated BBB by S&P and Baa1 by Moody's, reflecting the company's strong access to capital markets and disciplined debt management.

Investors have until October 13, 2026 to file a lead plaintiff motion.

top.title: Simply Good Foods Company Securities Fraud Class Action Result of Undisclosed Acquisition Failures and Over 27% Stock Decline - Investors may Contact Lewis Kahn, Esq., at Kahn Swick & Foti, LLC
top.summary: Simply Good Foods Company faces a securities fraud class action lawsuit for failing to disclose material information about its OWYN acquisition. The company concealed a product quality issue with pea protein that caused taste and texture problems, leading to negative reviews and depressed sales. Following disclosure of the issue and a $187 million impairment charge, the stock declined over 27% in a two-day period. Investors who purchased shares between October 24, 2024 and April 8, 2026 can file lead plaintiff applications by October 13, 2026.

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

EquipmentShare investors who purchased shares during the IPO or within the Class Period are encouraged to join the lawsuit, with a lead plaintiff deadline of September 21, 2026. The lawsuits allege material misstatements and omissions regarding business operations and financial disclosures.

gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

top.title: Vishay Intertechnology to Showcase Solutions for AI Infrastructure and Physical AI at PCIM Asia 2026
top.summary: Vishay Intertechnology announced it will showcase its semiconductor and passive technology portfolio at PCIM Asia 2026, featuring reference designs and products for AI infrastructure, software-defined vehicles, and humanoid robotics. The company will display solutions spanning grid-level to board-level power delivery, including solid-state transformers, power conversion modules, and automotive power modules for next-generation vehicle platforms.

top.title: Vishay Intertechnology Automotive Grade Ferrite Common Mode Chokes Save Board Space While Increasing Efficiency
top.summary: Vishay Intertechnology announced four new AEC-Q200 qualified automotive-grade common mode chokes (ICM5050-A, ICM6050-A, IFLN-1210BE-A, IFLN-1812CZ-A) that offer low DCR (0.4-12 mΩ), high current capability up to 14 A, and impedance up to 11 kΩ at 100 MHz. These compact surface-mount devices are designed for DC/DC power supplies, LCD displays, and in-vehicle networks, with samples and production quantities available now.

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

top.title: Zhihu Inc. Reports Unaudited Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results
top.summary: Zhihu Inc. reported Q2 2026 revenues of RMB690.1 million, down 3.7% year-over-year, with a net loss of RMB37.4 million compared to net income of RMB72.5 million in Q2 2025. Gross margin declined to 57.0% from 62.5%, primarily due to increased content-related costs. However, the company showed some positive signs with paid content and IP operations revenue growing year-over-year, and adjusted operating losses narrowing by 32.0%. The company maintained disciplined cost management with total operating expenses down 13.0% and continued share repurchases.
